units.source_text: 次日，小君来到中川的家里。

en.t: The next day, Kogimi came to Nakagawa's house.

units.source_text: 他姐姐等候已久，一见了他，便痛骂一顿：

en.t: His sister had been waiting for him for a long time, and as soon as she saw him, she scolded him fiercely:

units.source_text: 我好容易逃脱了，然而外人怀疑是难免的，真是可恶之极！

en.t: I barely managed to escape, but it is inevitable that outsiders will be suspicious. It is utterly hateful!

units.source_text: 像你这种无知小儿，公子怎么会差遣的？”

en.t: How could the young lord ever have sent an ignorant child like you on such an errand?"
Kogimi was too ashamed to show his face.

units.source_text: 在他看来，公子和姐姐两人都很痛苦，

en.t: As he saw it, both the young lord and his sister were suffering deeply,

units.source_text: 但此时也只得取出那张写上潦草字迹的怀纸来送上。

en.t: but for the moment he had no choice but to take out the folded paper covered in hurried handwriting and present it to her.

units.source_text: 空蝉虽有余怒，还是接受，读了一遍，想道：

en.t: Although Utsusemi was still angry, she accepted it, read it through once, and thought:

units.source_text: “我脱下的那件单衫怎么办呢？

en.t: "What will become of the unlined robe I took off?

units.source_text: 早已穿旧了的，难看死了。”

en.t: It was already worn out and terribly shabby."
Her heart was unsettled, and her thoughts wandered restlessly.
